revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a long industrial aisle between storage racks and workstations. Left-oblique view at near-medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Dull stone flooring, moderate backlight balanced by usable foreground fill. Visible subject: one adult with a curvy build wearing a burgundy coat over blue and charcoal clothing with straight-leg trousers, seated on the floor with legs extended forward, pelvis on the floor, back lightly supported by posture rather than lying flat. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, clean floor markings that do not form symbols or labels. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
